findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_combos, get_card_image · Private data: find_combos, my_collection, search_my_collection, semantic_card_search, what_can_i_build · Public sink: commander_staples, my_collection, search_my_collection, what_can_i_build · Destructive: check_deck_legality, deck_stats, find_combos, get_card, search_cards.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_combos, get_card_image · Private data: find_combos, my_collection, search_my_collection, semantic_card_search, what_can_i_build · Public sink: commander_staples, my_collection, search_my_collection, what_can_i_build · Destructive: check_deck_legality, deck_stats, find_combos, get_card, search_cards

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
